svg.aria-label: Synapse. OpenAI to Amodei to Anthropic, two hops. Multi-hop context recall 0.48 vector-only versus 0.92 graph RAG on a 4-question pilot.

g.text: Graph RAG for the questions vector search can't
An LLM extracts typed entities and edges into Neo4j. At query
time the question is linked to entities, an N-hop subgraph is
walked, and its chunks are fused with vector top-k. The
subgraph streams first, so the graph draws before the first
Same questions. Same LLM. Same chunks. Only the graph differs.
THE HOP VECTOR-ONLY RETRIEVAL CAN'T MAKE
link entities → walk N hops → fuse with vector top-k
